stem.text: The graph shows the antibody response when a person is injected first with antigen X and later with antigens X and Y.
Which curve shows the primary response to antigen Y?

stem.alt: Graph of antibody concentration against time. Antigen X is injected at the first arrow and antigen X and Y at the second arrow. Four curves: A is the tall peak after the first injection, D is the lower peak after the first injection, B is the tall peak after the second injection, and C is the lower peak after the second injection. Labels A, B, C and D are printed on the curves.
